retainedFailures.cause: Initial lint scanned copied Capacitor assets and found one control-character regex. Added precise generated-output ignores to lint/boundary walkers, retaining shared/native source checks, and used character-code validation.
Real local-bundle scene unavailable; investigated CommonJS default namespace and then the separate CSP requirement. No native or canvas PASS inferred from build output.
Temporary private diagnostic confirms Pixi unsafe-eval check rejects strict mobile CSP. Added pinned no-eval polyfill entry only for mobile; diagnostic console code removed from final source.
Canvas now works but new harness incorrectly expected an Enter button for a logged-out visitor. Assert actual existing Open identity/no entry/disabled-control behavior; no product gate weakened.
Existing build-graph contract still listed three apps. Added the fourth mobile consumer explicitly while retaining strict expected consumers/build-all checks.
Browser-fixture Event needed window.Event under existing JS globals; corrected without disabling lint.
Client compatibility desktop/mobile and desktop focus pass, mobile focus initial load fails with four retained ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED. Unchanged source/deadlines pass in serialized complete rerun.
Actual wrapper version and assembleDebug attempts fail because Java/JAVA_HOME is absent; compilation/signing/install not executed.
Resource preflight correctly refuses unqualified Android and owner-confirmed unavailable iOS paths; this is not native test acceptance.

limitations: N10-02 acceptance is false. A web bundle, generated Android files, cap sync and Chromium tests do not establish an APK/AAB build, native install or physical Android acceptance. Native resource/device gate remains external to this preparation.

Native auth/gameplay stays unavailable: local mobile request adapter returns503, no guest is created, no game socket opens and no credentials are stored. Native session/Keystore/ticket support and complete safety/business widgets must be separately qualified before enabling gameplay. Browser auth/Origin/CSRF and existing business panels retain their adapters.

Synthetic document visibility fixture only checks the preview adapter and renderer suspension; it does not prove active native session resync, focus authority, actual App bridge delivery, keyboard/back/safeareas or the prelocked30min/20visit/10background spike.

Pinned optional Pixi no-eval polyfills are scoped to the mobile csp-renderer entry. Next uses its original renderer entry and algorithm. The CommonJS namespace adapter handles the actual Next/Vite shapes. No CSP relaxation to unsafe-eval, auth bypass or new game-web deployment.

Browser mobile profile is Chromium iPhone13 emulation plus a360px local-preview viewport, not physical Android/iOS. Not all34CI specs were rerun; the selected matrix and local TLS flows cover changed shared-room adapters. No new performance/capacity/support-floor claim and original device budgets unchanged.

First study failure has four trace ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED initial-resource failures. Container networking overlapped, but causality is unproved. The same source and deadlines passed after image work completed and checks ran serially. Failed trace and every earlier failure remain private with hashes.

Template-provided generic Java example tests were removed because they do not qualify the app; no Java/native test PASS is claimed. Gradle wrapper checksum/line-ending attributes and template license are preserved; template branding/appId are preparation values, not store approval.

All44SQL,42prior evidence records, API/admin/contracts/world-sdk, historical151Mxx ledger, one room owner/separate worker, closed release defaults and distribution flags are preserved. N09-02 qualification atf80fdde remains scoped historical evidence; this slice does not rerun its complete693integration gate or activate admission.

No signing, APK/AAB/IPA, physical phone, staging, hosted publishing, deployment, store upload/TestFlight or iOS activation. Mac/Xcode/iPhone absent, N04-02/N07-04 external gates unchanged. Raw artifacts are local private storage, not an off-host archive.
